verdict.rationale:
YubiKey's core product design centers on FIDO2/WebAuthn and U2F as documented protocols, and community evidence corroborates that these keys function as WebAuthn/FIDO2 authenticators and PIV/GPG smartcards in real-world use across services. The docs describe passkey/WebAuthn support generically rather than confirming each specific service, but WebAuthn is a standard so this is a reasonable cross-service claim; independent community posts (yubikey-comm-14, yubikey-comm-16) reinforce broad protocol compatibility in practice.
missing for 10: explicit named confirmation/citations for Google, GitHub, Microsoft, and specific password manager integrations rather than generic standard-protocol docs.
